Title: Azure Web PubSub Premium tier reaches General Availability

Body.Content:
Azure Web PubSub Premium tier is now generally available. 

 

Web PubSub makes it easy for you to add real-time two-way communication to your web and mobile apps without worrying about infrastructure.  

This plan provides greater resiliency, scalability, and flexibility by enabling key enterprise-grade features, including:

  • Availability Zone support: distribute workloads evenly across multiple zones in a supported Azure region and redirect traffic to other zones in the event of a failure.
  • Autoscale capabilities: automatically scale up or down to meet actual resource usage. Autoscale is easy to configure and in most cases can save costs. 
  • An SLA of 99.95%.

Custom domain support: add your desired custom domain names to your application.

See Demos
